result.summary: The page is generally polished, but the fixed bottom navigation visibly overlaps the restaurant content and some horizontal carousels are clipped at the viewport edge.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation bar covers the lower portion of the second restaurant card, cutting off its image and hiding the associated restaurant details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding equal to the navigation bar height to the scrollable content, or ensure the final card can scroll fully above the fixed navigation.

issues.description: The category chip row and restaurant carousel show partially clipped items at the right edge of the screen, which can look like accidental horizontal overflow if the carousel behavior is not obvious.
issues.suggestion: Keep the carousel clipping intentional but provide a clearer scroll affordance, or adjust spacing so the next item is more visibly presented as horizontally scrollable.
